purpose: Teach: 書き込ま/予告編/エンターテインメント/ニックネーム/イコール/号機/点灯/アース
target_vocab: エンターテインメント

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社内文書に重要事項を書き込まないとな
lines.en: We need to make sure critical information is documented in our internal records.
lines.style: Decisive, measured opening. Lean forward slightly into each phrase. Expectations are clear but not harsh. Brief, authoritative pauses between clauses.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の予告編動画を作ります
lines.en: Understood. I'll prepare a teaser video for the new product.
lines.style: Respectful and present. Steady, unwavering eye contact. Absorbing the directive without defensiveness. Voice level and assured.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、エンターテインメント要素を商品に取り入れろ
lines.en: Make sure entertainment value is built into our products.
lines.style: Firm instruction, no doubt intended. Slight emphasis on the expectation itself. Clinical precision in the delivery—this is not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人にニックネームを付けて親しみやすくします
lines.en: Understood. I'll give the new hire a nickname to make them feel more welcomed.
lines.style: Pragmatic acknowledgment. Slight lift in energy showing he grasps the intent. Speaking as someone ready to implement immediately.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 品質と価格はイコールではないと社員に伝えろ
lines.en: Tell the staff that quality and price are not interchangeable.
lines.style: Calm, factual delivery of an important principle. No lecturing tone—this is reality stated plainly. Slight weight on the core message itself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工場の三号機の点検を予定します
lines.en: Understood. I'll schedule an inspection of the factory's Unit Three.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation, showing thoroughness. Methodical and competent. No wasted breath—just the facts of what will happen next.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、看板の点灯時間を見直せ
lines.en: Review the operating hours for the company's signage lighting.
lines.style: Straightforward directive delivered without urgency but with clarity. Settling back slightly—this is operational business, handled matter-of-factly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。電源のアース対策を強化します
lines.en: Understood. I'll strengthen the grounding precautions on the electrical systems.
lines.style: Final confirmation, spoken with finality and care. Slightly slower cadence, showing this detail matters. Respectful close to the exchange.
